task.title: Deleting quota notifications
task.shortdesc: To stop tracking storage thresholds or remove an inactive alerting endpoint in Red Hat Quay, you can delete quota notifications from organization or user namespaces.

note.p: Deleting a namespace quota also automatically deletes associated quota_warning and quota_error notification rules for that namespace. After you recreate a quota, you must create new notification rules.
